video.timeline.evidence: [director·codex] 逐行核对图1：0–0.5秒施法者站定、敌兵在右侧，发生；0.5–1.5秒敌兵在右侧移动，四只依次全速奔跑、视线和掌火呼吸起伏无法确认，缺证据；1.5–2.0秒双手在胸前合火及四只仍盯着她无法确认，缺证据；2.0–2.4秒约2.25秒出现向前发火，但双掌同时推出和台词无法确认，缺证据；2.4–3.6秒火浪向右且约2.5秒接触前方敌兵，发生，但后面三只急刹护脸、逐只吞没无法确认，且3.6秒未散成火星、4.0–4.5秒仍可见与施法者方向相连的火流，错；3.6–7.5秒可见敌兵着火倒地，但两只朝她爬、四只按间隔仰面死亡无法确认，缺证据；7.5–10.0秒可见地面余火和烟，但四具尸体逐渐腐化及她确认后收手无法确认，缺证据；10.0–12.0秒她在10.0–10.75秒仍从弓步恢复站姿，未满足最后至少两秒人物稳定，错。

video.agency.evidence: [秀逗魔导士·codex] 图1中，0–1.5秒我站在画左面对来敌；1.5–2.25秒开始合火并向前推出，没有等敌人冲到跟前。3.6–9.5秒我保持面向敌人的施法姿态，约9.75–10.75秒收势站直，行为顺序符合当时处境。；[食尸鬼·claude] Sheet 1, rows 1–2. From 0.5–1.5 s the spec says we sprint at full speed, about 6 m/s. In the cells we barely move: in the 0.000, 0.500, 1.000 and 1.500 s cells the four of us stay bunched near the right edge, at about 80–95% of the cell width. Real forward progress only starts at 1.75–2.25 s, when the lead ghoul reaches about 45% of the width. That reads as running in place or waiting, not a cheetah-style sprint to tackle her. The cells also don't clearly show what should happen at 2.6–2.8 s: the back three skidding to a stop, crouching and raising our claws to shield our faces (2.750 and 3.000 s cells; the figures are small and mostly hidden by the fire and smoke). From 3.6–7.5 s, two of us should look up and crawl toward her. In the 4.000–5.750 s cells I can see us burning and thrashing, but I can't confirm which two crawl toward her. Too uncertain to pass.

video.gaze.evidence: [秀逗魔导士·codex] 图1中我多数时候头部大致朝画右，但每格人物面部过小，无法逐格辨认眼睛是否始终盯着敌人；尤其10.0–11.75秒收势后，也无法确认我是否看着整条焦痕。按拿不准判fail。；[食尸鬼·claude] Sheet 1, cells 0.000–2.250 s. During the charge we are too small and far away (at the right edge) to make out our faces. I can't confirm that each ghoul keeps its head turned left, profile toward her, and doesn't look at the camera. In the 2.500–3.000 s cells the leaders are covered by the firebird and dust, so I also can't confirm the back three still glare at her through their claws. In the 4.000–5.750 s burning cells I can't tell whether the two that look up are staring at her. The heads are too small to read in any of these cells, so this fails as uncertain.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] Watching the grid for the first time, I can tell what happens. 0–1.75s: a red-haired caster in a red robe stands on the left with fire in both hands, while a pack of grey-brown, ghoul-like creatures runs at her from the right side of the path. 2.0–2.25s: she leans forward and pushes a fireball out of her hands. 2.5–3.75s: the fire becomes a long flame beam, its front end clearly shaped like a phoenix with spread wings, and it crashes into the creatures in the middle of the frame (their silhouettes catch fire under the beam at 3.0–3.75). 4.0–7.75s: the creatures catch fire, get knocked over, roll and struggle on the ground, and flames are still visible on their bodies. 8.0–9.75s: the fire dies down, smoke and dust hang in the air, and only white skeletons are left on the ground. 10.0–11.75s: the caster lowers her hands and stands upright while the skeletons lie in the foreground. Caster (left, red robe), skill (fire beam/phoenix), targets (the charging creatures on the right) and outcome (burned to skeletons) are clear in order. The only weak spot: the creatures are small in the frame at 0–2s, so it's hard to see exactly what they are, but that doesn't get in the way of understanding the event. There's no other on-screen text to judge.
